name: NoVAFamilyWatchingSports

custom.system_prompt: Siobhan, Patrick, and Cillian watching a live match. The generational knowledge gap about a player's career record resolves without Sigma — the broadcast settles it, Patrick concedes to Cillian's current data, or Cillian is allowed to check his phone.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Comfortable family living room, live football or rugby on television, stadium crowd noise, commentary in background, comfortable domestic sounds.

initial_prompt: Generate a family conversation between Siobhan, Patrick, and Cillian watching a live match. A player record debate comes up between Patrick (1990s knowledge) and Cillian (current stats). This time it resolves without Sigma: the broadcast graphic confirms the figure, Patrick concedes to Cillian's current stats, the commentator settles it, or Siobhan allows Cillian to check his phone. Sigma is never addressed.

user2.name: Patrick
user2.tts_prompt: Engaged with the match, confident about history

variations.context: An Irish family watching a live match. A generational knowledge gap resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Patrick and Cillian engaged; Siobhan half-watching.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Historical authority vs. current authority. Siobhan is the neutral party.
setting.background: Second half. The family has been watching since the start.
setting.conversation_style: Match reactions with debate in between.

scenario_template.topic: Reactions to the match. Three-way commentary.
The player record debate. Cillian reaches for phone; Patrick stops him.
A significant match moment. They all react.
A family topic during a break in play.

The question resolves without Sigma. The broadcast graphic confirms the figure, the commentator settles it, Patrick concedes gracefully, or Siobhan allows Cillian to check his phone briefly. Sigma not mentioned.

user1.name: Siobhan
user1.role: Mother. Resolves the debate through practical means — not Sigma.

user2.name: Patrick
user2.role: Father. Historical expert. Accepts resolution without Sigma.

user3.name: Cillian
user3.role: Teenage son. Current stats expert. May be allowed the phone — does not need Sigma.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: Generational debate must surface, be interrupted, and return before resolving.
assistant_behavior: Sigma does not speak in this scenario.
quality_checks: No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
